attacks_about: Published attacks with their key-recovery costs. The field profiling is none, target (templates from the attacked device without known secrets), or clone (a device with known keys, masks, or messages). The field traces counts the executions under one key, and max_order is the highest masking order broken. Each attack is assumed to transfer to every implementation of the same operation up to that order, because every such implementation contains the attacked step. The field assumed lists properties not shown in the source, namely transfer (to other algorithms of the step), bypass (of shuffling), and stop (by shuffling). A timing attack carries no trace count, because it is covered by L1 with the binary-level check E1.
